retryJob.title: Retry Failed Job
retryJob.description: Resolves the incident of this job so that its workers receive it again. Setting the retries alone would leave the job failed.
retryJob.custom: Set the retries, then resolve the incident
retryJob.fromDefinitionHint: Resolving the incident restores the retries of the task definition and hands the job out at once. Retries set for this job since it failed are kept instead, together with the moment chosen for its next delivery.
retryJob.saved: {{retries}} retries were saved for this job, but its incident is still open. Retry resolves the incident and keeps these retries.
retryJob.savedWithRetryAt: {{retries}} retries were saved for this job, with its next delivery not before {{time}}, but its incident is still open. Retry resolves the incident and keeps both.

updateRetries.title: Update Retries
updateRetries.description: Sets how many attempts this job has left and when it is handed out to a worker next.
updateRetries.newRetriesHelp: The failure which leaves none creates an incident. The engine refuses more than jobs.maxRetries.
updateRetries.retriesInvalid: Enter a whole number of at least 1
updateRetries.scheduleNowCutsBackoff: At once, cutting the current backoff short
updateRetries.delayInvalid: Enter a whole number of at least 1
updateRetries.retriesTooLarge: Enter at most {{max}}; the engine refuses more than jobs.maxRetries

failJob.title: Fail Job
failJob.messageHelp: Why the job failed. Kept as the job's last failure and, once no retries remain, part of the incident message.
failJob.outcomeBpmnError: With an error code the failure throws a BPMN error: a matching error event takes over, otherwise the job fails with an incident. No retry is spent.
failJob.outcomeRetry: Without an error code the failure spends one attempt and leaves {{retries}} retries. The job is handed out again after its backoff; if a worker received it over the job stream, not before that worker's lock lapses, as the UI cannot release it. The variables are dropped.
failJob.outcomeIncident: Without an error code this failure leaves no retries: the job fails with an incident and keeps the variables as its output.
failJob.retriesHelp: Optional; one less than now when empty. The engine caps it at jobs.maxRetries.
failJob.retriesInvalid: Enter a whole number of at least 0
failJob.retryBackoffHelp: Optional ISO-8601 duration overriding the task definition's backoff.
failJob.retryBackoffInvalid: Enter an ISO-8601 duration in weeks, days, hours, minutes or seconds, such as PT10S or P1D
